# Banks: the far bank (a long low ridge across the back, mossy top, slate mud face towards the
# pond) and two side banks (flattened lumps at the left and right edges). Built in place (world
# x, -z). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Moss --base-color 0.1804 0.2510 0.2392 --no-slot
material new Mud --base-color 0.2863 0.3216 0.4000 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Far --size 1 --location 0 4.95 0.0
scale 16 1.5 0.6
apply --scale
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
subdivide --cuts 12
select vert where "pos.z > 0.25"
randomize --amount 0.08 --seed 4
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name Left --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location -6.3 1.2 -0.25
scale 1.9 3.6 0.75
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name Right --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location 6.4 1.8 -0.3
scale 1.8 3.4 0.8
apply --scale
select Far Left Right
active Far
join
rename Far Bank
material assign Mud
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.55"
material assign Moss
select vert where "pos.z < -0.35"
delete vert
mode object
shade flat
export bank.glb
